headline: Sources: Mississippi State star QB Kamario Taylor's status vs. LSU uncertain
description: No. 16 Mississippi State star quarterback Kamario Taylor's status for Saturday's game at No. 22 LSU is in flux as he deals with a foot injury.

headline: Washington QB Williams unlikely to return vs. Purdue
description: Washington quarterback Demond Williams Jr. seems unlikely to return this week from a rib injury he suffered during the Huskies' loss to Iowa Friday, but coach Jedd Fisch said Monday that "we still have four days before we'll have to make that decision."

headline: Will Stein details how Kentucky countered LSU's defense
description: Coming off an upset win over the Tigers in overtime, Stein joins Read & React and explains the mindset in beating LSU's defensive strategies and the excitement after.

headline: Read & React crew analyzes Oklahoma's offense, Texas performance
description: Roman Harper and Cole Cubelic dive into some offensive actions that lifted the Sooners to a win over Texas, and acknowledge plays that hindered the Longhorns.

headline: Analyzing how key plays shaped Georgia's win vs. Alabama
description: Read & React's Cole Cubelic and Roman Harper examine how the creativity of the Crimson Tide's pass protections and the Bulldogs' timely defensive calls shaped the outcome of the game.

headline: Cole's Block Party: 'Live up to the standard!'
description: Read & React's Cole Cubelic and Roman Harper dive into some of the best blocks from Week 6, including a "bench escort" but the crew wants to see more.

headline: Roman Harper on South Carolina vs. UF: 'Everybody was on the same page'
description: Read & React's Harper dissects how communication and connected play were key aspects in the Gamecocks going to The Swamp and upsetting the Gators.

headline: Harper, Cubelic breakdown impressive Mizzou film clips
description: Read & React's Roman Harper and Cole Cubelic takes us into the film room, analyzing how No. 13 Missouri uses the pass to set up the run game.

headline: Roman, Are You Impressed? Week 6 has big highlights all around
description: Read & React's Cole Cubelic uses dynamic plays from all of college football to see if he can get Roman Harper to say yes to the infamous question.

headline: Cole Cubelic analyzes South Carolina improvements, advises Florida
description: Cubelic dives into one of the biggest upsets of Week 6 in South Carolina's win over Florida on The Paul Finebaum Show.

headline: How every 2027 five-star college football prospect will fit
description: There are 23 five-star players in the class, and we scout each one's game for the next level.

headline: Sumrall focuses on Gators' balance, Texas QB Manning misconception
description: Jon Sumrall speaks on his part in keeping Florida level-headed through the season's ebbs and flows, and shares his thoughts on an overlooked trait in Arch Manning.

headline: Texas A&M coach Elko says he regrets 'cesspool' comments
description: Mike Elko said his viral remark after the Aggies' loss to Missouri was made in the heat of the moment.

headline: RB CJ Baxter reveals what makes No. 15 Kentucky, Stein special
description: Baxter emphatically talks about the Wildcats preparation process, and the "swagger" of Will Stein as UK looks to build on winning back-to-back OT thillers.

headline: QB Gunner Stockton attributes his accuracy to O-Line, skills group
description: Stockton shares that because of the talent throughout No. 1 Georgia's offensive line and skills players, he is able to complete risky passes and maintain an 82% completion rate.
